purpose: Live fan microphone prediction and fixed-reference comparison
feature: Hann-windowed, DC-removed, one-sided FFT band mean-square energy in dBFS; six independent bands
normalizer: Fit per-band median and max(3dB,1.4826*MAD) on first150 frames only; z=.5+.5*(band-center)/(scale+abs(band-center)); then freeze
bootstrap: One pass over normalized fit frames for SNN and continuous banks, same band seeds seed+band; no calibration/probe training of source models
neural: Six independent SensingPredictor instances (12 units each), existing fixed tau/input/readout/eligibility/learning constants; SNN and continuous control differ only by spiking dynamics
fixed_reference: Freeze a copy of the fully fitted adaptive SNN parameters. Parameters and normalization stay fixed; transient state evolves on the same live frames
calibration: Independent trained copies process next150 frames with matching learning flags; discard their updates. Threshold=max(1e-9,maximum sqrt(mean6(previous_forecast-target)^2) after25-frame warmup). Strict > produces zero calibration alarms by construction, without guaranteeing future rate
probe: Next100 feature frames are sealed and never trained on; no source updates during collection. Checkpoint0 and each300 monitor frames evaluate frozen copies on this identical20s tape, reset transient state and ignore first25 frames. Repeated probe evaluations are correlated; no outcome tuning
monitor: Predict before receiving target; score and emit threshold alarm before updating. Score is sqrt(mean six squared errors); warmup25frames, cooldown25frames. Same live frames for all five arms; states continue through monitor; no event/fault labels
clock: Model time is sample-derived (global_frame+1)*.2 seconds at nominal16kHz, distinct from monotonic delivery timestamps. Raw PCM does not carry measured hardware timestamps
comparison: Each300-frame nonoverlapping monitoring block reports paired next-frame MSE against fixed SNN, ANN, EMA and persistence, plus cumulative MSE and observed alarms/minute. First block omits25 warmup targets. Relative improvement=(fixed_mse-adaptive_mse)/fixed_mse, null if fixed_mse=0
report: Prediction error and observed alarm rate, not detection accuracy, faults, confirmed false positives, independent trials or chip energy. No claims from changes in surprise alone
signal_check: A short pre-model capture may confirm signal/frequencies before this protocol. Capture source must be a physical input, never an output monitor; no default/gain changes
privacy: Raw audio is discarded after feature extraction. Exact feature/forecast traces and learned arrays stay in a private local state directory, outside Git. Publish aggregate measurements only
stopping: Continuous until stopped or capture failure; checkpoints every60 audio seconds. Preserve the first learning curve and negative outcomes; parameter changes require a new named session/protocol
